# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 106 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 106

Jesus said: "When you make the two into one, you will become sons of man, and when you say, 'Mountain, be moved!' it will move."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Make the two into one" — the unification process specified
- "Sons of man" — the plural; both ontological status and the mountain-moving power are results of unification
- "Be moved!" — the passive imperative for the mountain
